shots.intent: 首屏一眼认出是翻盖抽取式婴儿柔巾，靠釉面质感与铜色托盘拉出高级感
shots.textZone: top-center clean band reserved for rendered headline and one caption line

shots.intent: 把吐奶、翻洒、异味这类高频狼狈摊开，逼出随手就得有一片干净布的需求
shots.textZone: left column clean band for two short lines

shots.intent: 用同机位左右分栏对照纸感碎屑与布感韧度，把换布理由讲清
shots.textZone: two columns each with a caption band beneath; top band for headline

shots.textZone: bottom band for one short label line

shots.intent: 把翻盖卡扣与抽取口的单手结构讲明白，降低使用顾虑

shots.intent: 用四处日常角落覆盖居家和外出场景，把复购理由铺开
shots.textZone: top band headline; one caption under each of the four quadrants

shots.intent: 用多层水织工序示意建立洁净感，不写任何检测或成分数字
shots.textZone: left column stacked labels; bottom band for headline

shots.intent: 以整组塑封外箱与多包排列呈现囤货感，不含任何数量与规格数字
shots.textZone: top band for one short line only

shots.intent: 用最静的一组静物收束整页，留出下单点击的空白与一句行动文案
shots.textZone: lower band for one headline and one short CTA line
